renderer: deterministic browser-native DOM and CSS shutter field
primitiveBudget: 13 generated DOM shutters, 39 initial internal segments, locally appended segments after sustained attention
memoryRule: brief attention remains geometry-neutral; a completed dwell edits the watched shutter's own geometry and segment grammar; four local edits persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses and holds one shutter; watch control and Enter / Space commit equivalent deterministic dwell; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: flat Canvas mask, browser-native WebGL ribbon volume, and inline SVG syntax -> semantic DOM buttons with CSS clip geometry and nested segment structure
compositionRupture: centered negative mask, faceted volume, and broken sentence -> oblique vertical stack of irregular shutters on a paper-like field
encounterRupture: return cadence, opposing pressure pair, and selection/departure -> sustained observation of one local shutter; the watched object edits itself
temporalRupture: three-beat return, simultaneous opposition, and pulse sealing -> dwell threshold where duration is the causal material and brief looks are refused
mediumRupture: Canvas pixels, WebGL ribbons, and SVG paths -> actual DOM nodes, CSS variables, clip paths, and appended internal segment elements
changedRule: Attention is geometry-neutral below 0.64 seconds. Only a completed watch edits the watched shutter itself: its fold, dimensions, angle, offset, and internal segment count change locally.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a sparse oblique stack of thirteen dark shutters on a paper field. A valid dwell adds an internal segment and visibly refolds only the observed shutter; four local edits compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if a brief look folds, if waiting changes only colour, if the watched shutter stays exact, if all shutters edit identically, if the blind work reads as a generic accordion, or if later edits reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v041 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish local self-editing attention shutters from v038-v040 or if the cultural translation is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
